story.title: Anupam Kher denies Rs 400-500 crore net worth claims;
story.summary: Anupam Kher has addressed rumors about his net worth, stating it is significantly lower than reported. He explained his choice to live in rented accommodation, prioritizing freedom over property ownership. Kher mentioned the ease this lifestyle brings compared to managing multiple properties. He emphasized the emotional importance of purchasing a home for his mother in Shimla.
